name: section-wrapper
title: Section Wrapper
summary: The page-section container every block sits in: fluid vertical rhythm, site margins, and a quiet reveal on scroll.

intent.design: Invisible when it works. It sets the vertical rhythm of a page with one fluid padding token and keeps content on the site margins. Nothing about it should be noticed; it exists so every other block agrees on spacing, width and background handling. The contrast variant is how a page gets a dark band without any block knowing.
intent.motion: Content rises a few pixels and fades in once, the first time the section enters the viewport, with children staggered so the eye reads top to bottom. It is a settle, not an entrance. If a viewer can name the effect it is too much, so distance and stagger are small and the easing is the standard enter curve.

reveal.description: Reveal children on first entry into the viewport

placement: Wraps the content of every other block; blocks do not set their own vertical padding or site margins
Consecutive sections share the same background unless one uses the contrast variant
a11y: Renders a landmark section element; add aria-labelledby pointing at the block heading when one exists
Reveal collapses to a fade with no movement under prefers-reduced-motion
doNotChange: The single fluid padding token; do not replace it with fixed breakpoints
The reveal fires once; it must never replay on scroll up

variants.name: contrast
variants.description: Inverted colours for a dark band; children inherit the on-contrast text colour

variants.name: flush
variants.description: No vertical padding, for full-bleed blocks that manage their own rhythm

notes: This is a foundation piece, not a Matrix block. Convert it to templates/_components/section.twig as an embed exposing a `content` block, and have other converted blocks embed it instead of adding their own padding
Pass variant through a params map: {% embed '_components/section' with { variant: 'contrast' } %}
